content: The silence that fell over the council hall was absolute, broken only by the rhythmic tap-tap-tap of a knotted wooden stick on the polished flagstones. Snowflakes drifted through the doorway, melting upon the heated stone floor like dying moths.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
